'''Miyuu Sawai''' (Japanese: '''沢井美優''' ''Sawai Miyū'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sawai was born on October 23, 1987, in {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, she became a model and gravure idol, working since at least 2002. She later became a voice actress and worked on some anime series. Sawai voiced [[Astrid]], a {{pkmn|Trainer}} with a {{me|Absol}} who appeared in {{aniseries|XY}} of {{aniseries|PTS}}. In addition, she has acted in several live-action works. Sawai is currently affiliated with BOX Corporation.
